Gold Nova 4 here. Your K/D is really high ( mine is only 0.96 :/ ). As you said you win twice for every game you loose. Well that is why you don't rank up. Let's talk about the elo system a bit. Imagine you have two apples. One apple is stolen from you. How many apples do you have? In real life you would have one left, but in CSGO you would have zero. So basically one loss nulifies two wins. To rank up, you need to start winning more games in a row and you should be outa there in no time! Good luck my friend :)

Yes you will rank up if you keep winning and since you seem to have a decent K/D you're probably not getting carried for a majority of those. Don't worry you'll get there just keep grinding. It helps to lobby up with people who you played with who you know would be good teammates. Although there is a lot more satisfaction, for me anyway to win in when solo queuing.

34 games is nothing, since GO was the first CS game I really played I was down in low silvers forever. If you are doing as good as you say you are you'll get out don't sweat it. Rank isn't everything, there's guys who are DMG who have gotten carried all the way who still don't check corners or know how to spray. Just play the best you can
